title: ASP.NET Core Data Protection
description: Built-in APIs for encrypting and decrypting data at rest in ASP.NET Core applications.

data.text: What is ASP.NET Core Data Protection?

The `Microsoft.AspNetCore.DataProtection` package provides a simple API for encrypting and decrypting data. It is designed for protecting sensitive data at rest, such as cookies, query strings, and form values.
Use `IDataProtector` to protect and unprotect payloads. The protector is purpose-bound, meaning different protectors cannot decrypt each other's data.

data.title: Protecting Data
data.content: Encrypt and decrypt data with IDataProtector.

data.text: Use `IDataProtector` with a time limit to create tokens that automatically expire, which is useful for email confirmation and password reset links.

data.title: Time-Limited Protection
data.content: Create a token that expires after 24 hours.

terms.definition: The interface used to protect and unprotect data.
The factory for creating IDataProtector instances.
A string passed to CreateProtector that isolates protectors from each other.

data.title: Warning
data.text: Data Protection keys are machine-specific by default. For web farms, configure a shared key storage location like Azure Blob Storage or a network share.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Configure shared key storage for multi-instance deployments
data.takeaway: Data Protection simplifies encryption for common ASP.NET Core scenarios without managing keys manually.
